about: Hardware that appears in clean published benchmark rows but is not a preset: used only to fit and check the per-family factors (tools/fit-families.mjs), never shown in the app. Same fields and conventions as data/machines.json. The values come from vendor datasheets as cited; they were not re-fetched when this file was written (see uncertain).

machines.name: Tesla V100 SXM2 32 GB
machines.notes: Tensor FP16 125 TFLOPS (SXM2); Volta accumulates FP32 at full rate.
uncertain: values and URL as remembered from the vendor datasheet, not fetched when this file was written

machines.name: Tesla V100 PCIe 16 GB
machines.notes: Tensor FP16 112 TFLOPS (PCIe). The CUDA scoreboard's 'Tesla V100' (32 GB, variant not stated) is mapped to the SXM2 row.
uncertain: values and URL as remembered from the vendor datasheet, not fetched when this file was written

machines.name: Tesla T4 16 GB
machines.notes: Mixed-precision (FP16/FP32) tensor 65 TFLOPS; a 70 W card that rarely holds its boost clock.
uncertain: values and URL as remembered from the vendor datasheet, not fetched when this file was written

machines.name: Instinct MI100 32 GB
machines.notes: Peak FP16 matrix 184.6 TFLOPS; HBM2 4096-bit at 2.4 Gbps.
uncertain: values and URL as remembered from the vendor page, not fetched when this file was written

machines.name: Ryzen AI Max+ 395, CPU only
machines.notes: The CPU half of the strixHalo preset: 16 Zen 5 cores with the full 512-bit FPU, 128 BF16 flop/clk/core x 16 x 3.0 GHz base = 6.1 (the data/machines.json CPU convention), 256-bit LPDDR5x-8000.
uncertain: product page not fetched when this file was written

machines.name: Ryzen 9 9900X, 4x DDR5-3600
machines.notes: Memory ran at DDR5-3600 with four DIMMs (2 ch x 64 bit x 3600 / 8 = 57.6 GB/s, as the benchmark row states). 12 Zen 5 cores x 128 BF16 flop/clk x 4.4 GHz base = 6.8.

machines.name: Ryzen 9 3950X, DDR4-3600
machines.notes: Dual-channel DDR4-3600 = 57.6 GB/s (as the row states). Zen 2 has no BF16: tflopsSpec is the FP32 FMA ceiling, 16 cores x 32 flop/clk x 3.5 GHz base = 1.8, so it is not on the same footing as the Zen 5 rows.
